notes: Redesigned overview with Overall, Gym and Yoga sections, clean progress circles, sixteen-week charts, and 8/52-week averages. Tap a bar or swipe any circle to select the same week across all sections. Circles and bars use matching grey, green, blue, purple and orange achievement levels. Gym credits are 0.4 plus 0.04 per completed set; yoga credits are 0.4 plus 0.02 per minute, both capped at 1.2 per nonempty session. Yoga contributes 75% to Overall. Historical totals recalculate without changing logged sets, minutes or drafts.
